Consistently Excellent Since 2022 — And Service That Goes the Extra Mile
Jul 2026 • Friends
Been coming to Maguro Studio since summer 2022, and the quality and service have stayed consistently excellent — no drop-off at all, which says a lot for a sushi spot.

This visit, the yuzu plum wine stole the show for me — much better than the choya. Paired it with their wagyu fried rice, which never disappoints. For sashimi, I always go unseared, hamachi included. Personally I think searing is often used to mask fish that’s past its prime, so getting to eat it raw and fresh here is exactly what I want (searing has its place — I’ll save that technique for a Niçoise salad, just not my sushi).

I came in yesterday around 1:30pm, right at last call, with the restaurant closing at 2pm. Despite the timing, the staff were incredibly accommodating — they stayed back to serve us without any rushing and even encouraged us to take our time and enjoy the meal. That kind of service really doesn’t go unnoticed. Thank you very much!

Maguro has a funky, no-frills, straightforward dining vibe that I really appreciate. Along with Roka Fella (which leans more fusion and plays with sight and taste), it’s easily one of my two favorite sushi restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City.

Fantastic! Ask for Phong as your server and kudos to Thien the manager
Dec 2025 • Family
My family and I are visiting Vietnam and was recommended this place, so I am forwarding this recommendation to all of you reading this. The food was absolutely fantastic, you could feel the love the chef put into each and every dish. The service from Phong was the best I’ve ever experienced especially as a server in the industry myself. He was so attentive and paid attention to every detail making sure we were more than satisfied. The manager Thien was also incredible. After explaining my sister’s shellfish allergy and lack of love for sushi despite the rest of my family and I loving it, he went out of his way to ask the chef to make a california roll (which is not on their menu) especially just for her to make sure her experience was just as fantastic as ours. Be sure to make time to eat here because you wont regret it.
